extraction.Name: George L. McGaa
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee to his 160 acre allotment at the time he got it, for he did not want to pay the taxes; but he was advised that it was reported to the Tax Collector, and taxes would be charged against it, so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged his 160 acre allotment to Peter Duhamell, of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $1250.00; that he was unable to make payments, and in about a year's time, Duhamell foreclosed on his allotment
extraction.Buyer: Peter Duhamell of Rapid City, South Dakota, foreclosed for $1250.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he did not want to pay the taxes; he was advised that it was reported to the Tax Collector, and taxes would be charged against it; he had kept the taxes paid up on his allotment up to the time that he mortgaged it
extraction.Occupation/Income: only source of income at the present time is by common labor
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health; has a wife and one minor child to support; family has good health; he hardly considers $1250.00 a fair price for the land at the time of foreclosure; has never received any help from the County or Government; mortgage and foreclosure occurred around 1920; affidavit sworn November 20, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
